description: Use this when someone names an animal of their vet clinic, to get its id before booking it or changing its details. Returns up to five animals whose name contains every word given, with id, name and clinic; namesakes are told apart by the last two digits of the owner's phone. Not for browsing animals or reading an animal's history, records or vaccinations.

clinicId.description: Only patients of this clinic; every clinic of the account when absent

search.description: The patient's name as the user gave it, or part of it. Every word must appear in the stored name, in any order, ignoring case and accents.

name: find_patient

patients.description: The patients whose name matches, with the ids the other tools take. Contact details, dates of birth, notes and clinical records are never returned.

phoneEnding.description: The last two digits of the patient's phone, given only when two patients share this name

tooManyMatches.description: More than 5 patients match: none are returned; ask the user for more of the name

title: Find an animal by name
